title: CleanCuts part recipe
description: A portable recipe over a mesh: what to cut and where (ADR-018). The mesh file holds the part geometry (STL or 3MF, canonical WCS, mm); slice_z and cut_z default to the documented 2.5D values (midpoint of the top two vertex heights; the part's minimum Z). See docs/part.md.

name.description: Human-readable name (used in paths and messages).

mesh.description: The geometry file (STL ASCII/binary or 3MF) in the canonical WCS (mm). Resolved by the CLI; the core never reads files.

slice_z.description: Height at which the 2.5D section is taken. Must lie strictly between two adjacent vertex heights (the 2.5D rule, ADR-017). Omit for the default: midpoint of the two topmost vertex heights.

cut_z.description: Tool-tip height of the cut. Must be strictly below slice_z and at or above the stock bottom. Omit for the default: the part's minimum Z (a cut through the part).

operation.description: profile (default): mill each contour — profiles outside, voids inside (v0.2). pocket (ADR-022): clear the region outer minus the kept bosses down to cut_z with the trochoidal raster. Bosses are never milled (ADR-021).

material.description: Workpiece material name, matched against the tool's feeds[].material when feed/spindle are not given explicitly (ADR-024). E.g. "aluminum-6061".

stepover.description: Pocket stepover s in mm (ADR-022/026). Omit for the default: the tool radius. Must be <= 2x the tool radius (coverage), else the plan is refused.

lead_in.description: Entry lead-in so the cutter starts outside the cut area (ADR-023). Omit for the safe default (a tangent lead-in of min(tool radius, 3 mm)).

kind.description: straight: extend the entry edge's line backward. tangent: an arc tangent to the entry edge, on the material-removal side. Default: tangent.

length.description: Lead-in length in mm. Default: min(tool radius, 3 mm).
